newsitem.title: UK: UK's Rifkind-force cannot solve Albania crisis.
newsitem.headline: UK's Rifkind-force cannot solve Albania crisis.

text.p: Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said on Tuesday that Britain was "extremely concerned" about the crisis in Albania.
In a statement, Rifkind said: "Stability cannot be restored by force alone. President (Sali) Berisha must work with the opposition to restore faith in the democratic process."
Rifkind said he would discuss further international action with Britain's partners in the European Union and elsewhere.

"We will keep up the pressure for Albania to live up to its obligations as a full member of the OSCE (Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe) and Council of Europe. The OSCE in particular has a key role to play," Rifkind said.
"We, the IMF (International Monetary Fund) and EU have already offered expert assistance on resolving the economic crisis. I hope that President Berisha accepts such advice."
Rifkind added the British embassy in Tirana was in contact with the 80 to 100 British citizens who remained in Albania. He gave no details.
